Requirement: The space link shall transfer telemetry at 2 Mbps using the coding approach identified in CCSDS 131.0-B.
The spacecraft shall accept telecommands from the ground segment.
The ground segment shall deliver space packets to mission operations within 2 s.
The radio shall provide a link margin of at least 3 dB at 10 deg elevation.
The onboard data handler shall encapsulate payload bytes in space packets as specified by CCSDS 133.0-B.
The ground software shall be fast and adequate for operators.
